question.text: What will be Grupo Casas Bahia's (BHIA3) closing share price on 27 November 2026?
question.resolution_criteria: This question resolves to the closing price of Grupo Casas Bahia S.A. (B3 ticker BHIA3) for the trading session of 27 November 2026, as reported in the "Close" column of the Yahoo Finance historical data page for BHIA3.SA: https://finance.yahoo.com/quote/BHIA3.SA/history/. Values are in Brazilian reais, so a close printed as 0.83 in that column resolves as 0.83 (i.e., R$0.83). The price used is the close for that session in the share structure in effect on that date, so if a share grouping (grupamento/reverse split) or comparable share-count-changing corporate action takes effect on or before 27 November 2026, the question resolves to the post-action price displayed for that session. If Yahoo Finance does not display a closing price for that session (for example because trading in BHIA3 was suspended or the exchange was closed), the question resolves to the most recent closing price reported for BHIA3 on or before 27 November 2026. If that Yahoo Finance page is inaccessible or no longer shows historical prices, the B3 official closing price for 27 November 2026 as reported by [credible sources](https://www.metaculus.com/faq/#definitions) will be used.

research:
I've collected price data and news, and now I'm writing up the findings.

## 1. Resolution source

- 2026-11-13: Yahoo Finance's data feed for BHIA3.SA, which sits behind the history page, shows the last close as **R$0.68** on 13 Nov, with volume of 3.68M shares. The previous close was R$0.68 on 12 Nov. The feed lists the 52-week high as R$4.17. Note that the question background says R$0.69 for 13 Nov, but Yahoo shows 0.68. [Yahoo chart API](https://query1.finance.yahoo.com/v8/finance/chart/BHIA3.SA?range=3mo&interval=1d)
- 2026-11-14: StockPulse also recorded R$0.68. [StockPulse](https://api.stockpulse.de/newstex/913590835)
- Adjusted close equals close across the last 3 months, so there has been no grouping (reverse split) or other adjustment in that window.

## 2. Current status

- Nothing has settled the question. The stock has traded in a narrow R$0.64 to 0.72 band since 29 Oct, after a collapse in late October.

## 3. Recent news (newest first)

- 2026-11-13: GPA and Casas Bahia signed a definitive settlement ending 17 years of disputes. GPA no longer has to reimburse R$424M of tax contingencies. GPA still owes Casas Bahia R$231.8M in arbitral debt, which will be handled under GPA's extrajudicial recovery plan. BHIA3 closed flat that day. [Financenews](https://financenews.com.br/2026/11/gpa-celebra-acordo-com-grupo-casas-bahia-para-encerrar-de-forma-definitiva-pendencias-e-disputas-entre-as-companhias/), [Seu Dinheiro](https://www.seudinheiro.com/2026/empresas/casas-bahia-bhia3-e-gpa-pcar3-fazem-as-pazes-e-encerram-batalha-envolvendo-r-11-bilhao/), [EconomicNews](https://economicnewsbrasil.com.br/2026/11/14/acordo-entre-gpa-e-casas-bahia-divida/)
- 2026-11-10: In its answer to the CVM's query, the company said management had not decided on any store closures. [Visno](https://visnoinvest.com.br/news/16391/casas-bahia-bhia3-adia-balanco-do-3t26-e-nega-decisao-sobre-lojas), [Acionista](https://acionista.com.br/grupo-casas-bahia-bhia3-esclarece-noticia-sobre-fechamento-de-lojas/)
- 2026-11-06: Third-quarter results were postponed from 11 Nov to 10 Dec. [Acionista](https://acionista.com.br/casas-bahia-bhia3-adia-resultados-para-dezembro-em-meio-a-recuperacao-judicial/)
- 2026-10-26: The stock opened at R$0.83, about 42% below the 23 Oct close of R$1.44. This was the first session after Brazil's presidential run-off. It closed at R$0.90, then fell to R$0.73 on 28 Oct and R$0.64 on 29 Oct. I could not find a clear stated cause for the crash. [Investir é o caminho](https://investirecocaresocomecar.com.br/casas-bahia-bhia3-adia-balanco-3t26/)
- 2026-10-21: The court accepted the recovery case for processing and gave the company **30 days to file documents, or risk revocation**. [same source](https://investirecocaresocomecar.com.br/casas-bahia-bhia3-adia-balanco-3t26/)
- 2026-08-31: The stock rose about 40% intraday after the court brought forward the 180-day stay period, which protects the group from creditor actions until 15 Feb 2027. [BP Money](https://bpmoney.com.br/mercado/acoes-da-casas-bahia-bhia3-disparam-40-apos-justica-blindar-varejista-na-recuperacao-judicial/)
- 2026-08-17: The stock fell about 33% to R$0.44 on the first session after the judicial recovery filing. [InfoMoney](https://www.infomoney.com.br/mercados/bhia3-acao-da-casas-bahia-desaba-mais-de-30-e-vai-a-r-045-com-pedido-recuperacao-judicial/)
- Analyst targets: Itaú BBA is neutral with a 2027 target of R$1.00 [Acionista](https://acionista.com.br/casas-bahia-bhia3-em-recuperacao-judicial-e-impacto-no-mercado/). Orion rates it sell with a target of R$1.20 [Orion](https://orionresearch.com.br/noticias/casas-bahia-bhia3-despenca-prejuizo-recuperacao-judicial/).

## 4. Base rates and recent path

Selected Yahoo closes, all in R$:
- **August:** 0.65 (13 Aug), 0.44 (17 Aug), 0.34 (27 Aug, the low), 0.66 (31 Aug), 0.90 (1 Sep)
- **September:** 0.67 to 0.82 through mid-September, then up to 1.22 by 30 Sep
- **October:** 1.60 (9 Oct, the peak), 1.09 (14 Oct), 1.43 (20 Oct), 1.44 (23 Oct), 0.90 (26 Oct), 0.73 (28 Oct), 0.64 (29 Oct), 0.69 (30 Oct)
- **November:** 0.67, 0.70, 0.69, 0.71, 0.72, 0.71, 0.70, 0.68, 0.68 (3 to 13 Nov)

What the pattern shows:
- **Recent volatility:** over the last 11 sessions the daily moves have mostly been 3% or less. That is far calmer than August to October, when 10-observation swings of ±40-60% happened several times.
- **Volume:** it has fallen from 20-36M shares a day in October to 3.7-8.7M a day in November.
- **Statistical baseline:** the provided calculation from 3 years of 10-session returns gives p5 0.44, p25 0.59, p50 0.64, p75 0.69, p95 1.05.
- **Seasonality:** I found no meaningful Black Friday or seasonal pattern for this stock, and I did not compute year-by-year moves from 16 to 27 Nov.

## 5. Other forecasts

- None of the Kalshi or Polymarket markets supplied match BHIA3. They cover unrelated football, tennis, elections and IBOVESPA highs.
- I did not find a Manifold or Metaculus market on BHIA3, and there is no listed options market for it.

## 6. Upcoming events before 27 Nov

- **Around 20 Nov:** the 30-day deadline from the 21 Oct decision to file documents falls in this period. Missing it risks revocation. This could move the price either way.
- **20 Nov:** B3 holiday. That leaves 9 trading sessions from 17 to 27 Nov.
- **Possible news:** confirmation of the roughly 200 further store closures, a next monthly report from the judicial administrator, or leaks about creditor talks led by Camille Faria.
- **27 Nov:** Black Friday, a normal trading day.
- **After resolution:** results on 10 Dec and the recovery plan due around late December.

Sources: listed inline above, plus [Investing.com history](https://www.investing.com/equities/via-varejo-sa-historical-data) and [Forbes](https://forbes.com.br/forbes-money/2026/08/acao-da-casas-bahia-bhia3-despenca-apos-pedido-de-recuperacao-judicial-envolvendo-dividas-de-r173-bi/).

I found no event that settles this question. BHIA3 last closed at **R$0.68 on 13 Nov 2026** (Yahoo). For three weeks it has stayed in a tight R$0.64-0.73 band, after a very volatile August to October. One correction to the question background: it says R$0.69 for 13 Nov, but Yahoo's own data shows R$0.68.

## 1. Resolution source
- 2026-11-13: Yahoo's chart API, which feeds the BHIA3.SA history page, shows a close of 0.68. The previous close on 12 Nov was also 0.68, and that day traded between 0.67 and 0.70. The adjusted close matches the close, so no corporate action is pending in the data. [Yahoo API](https://query1.finance.yahoo.com/v8/finance/chart/BHIA3.SA?range=3mo&interval=1d)
- Recent closes from the same data:
  - 19 Oct to 23 Oct: 1.19, 1.43, 1.38, 1.32, 1.44
  - 26 Oct to 30 Oct: 0.90, 0.91, 0.73, 0.64, 0.69
  - 3 Nov to 6 Nov: 0.67, 0.70, 0.69, 0.71 (2 Nov was a holiday)
  - 9 Nov to 13 Nov: 0.72, 0.71, 0.70, 0.68, 0.68
- Volume fell from about 20-30M shares a day in October to 3.7-12.6M a day in November.
- 2026-11-14: A Stockpulse report gave R$0.68 "on Nov 14". That was a Saturday, so it is the 13 Nov close carried over. [Stockpulse](https://api.stockpulse.de/newstex/913590835)

## 2. Current status
- Nothing has settled the question. I found no reverse split (grupamento) announced that would take effect before 27 Nov.
- 2026-08 or 09 (exact date unclear): B3 notified the company that the stock had been below R$1 since 21 July. It has until 1 March 2027 to fix this, so a grupamento before 27 Nov looks unlikely. The last one, in 2023, combined 25 shares into 1. [Economic News Brasil](https://economicnewsbrasil.com.br/2026/09/17/casas-bahia-abaixo-r-1-bhia3-grupamento/)

## 3. Recent news (newest first)
- 2026-11-13: GPA and Casas Bahia signed a final settlement ending their disputes from the 2009 partnership. GPA no longer has to reimburse R$424M of tax contingencies. A R$231.8M arbitration debt that GPA owes Casas Bahia is kept and will be handled under GPA's extrajudicial recovery plan. [Financenews](https://financenews.com.br/2026/11/gpa-celebra-acordo-com-grupo-casas-bahia-para-encerrar-de-forma-definitiva-pendencias-e-disputas-entre-as-companhias/), [Seu Dinheiro](https://www.seudinheiro.com/2026/empresas/casas-bahia-bhia3-e-gpa-pcar3-fazem-as-pazes-e-encerram-batalha-envolvendo-r-11-bilhao/), [Economic News Brasil](https://economicnewsbrasil.com.br/2026/11/14/acordo-entre-gpa-e-casas-bahia-divida/)
- Week of 9-13 Nov: The judicial administrator's report showed a R$13.7bn net loss for January-August. That is about 19 times the company's market value. [Investir e começar](https://investirecocaresocomecar.com.br/casas-bahia-bhia3-prejuizo-13-bilhoes-8-meses/)
- 9-10 Nov: The CVM letter about the Veja store-closure report, and the company's denial, came and went with no visible price move (closes of 0.72 and 0.71).
- 26-29 Oct: The stock fell from 1.44 to 0.64, about 55% in four sessions. I could not find a specific news cause. Commentary on possible debt-to-equity conversion and dilution was circulating. [Arevista](https://arevista.com.br/acoes/bhia3-reduz-divida-mas-novas-acoes-aumentam-risco-de-diluicao/)
- 2026-10-21: The court accepted the judicial recovery for processing. Debt is R$17.3bn, and the 180-day freeze on creditor actions runs from 19 Aug. [Suno](https://www.suno.com.br/noticias/bhia3-recuperacao-judicial-casas-bahia-go/), [BPMoney](https://bpmoney.com.br/negocios/empresas/casas-bahia-bhia3-justica-sp-aprova-recuperacao-judicial/)
- 14 and 20 Oct: The stock fell about 24% to 1.09 on 14 Oct, then rose 20% to 1.43 on 20 Oct. The reported drop on the 14th doesn't fit Yahoo's data, which shows 1.44 to 1.09 on what looks like 13 Oct, a fall closer to 25%.
- 2026-08-17: After the judicial recovery filing, the stock fell about 33% to around R$0.44-0.45. [InfoMoney](https://www.infomoney.com.br/mercados/bhia3-acao-da-casas-bahia-desaba-mais-de-30-e-vai-a-r-045-com-pedido-recuperacao-judicial/), [Orion](https://orionresearch.com.br/noticias/casas-bahia-bhia3-despenca-prejuizo-recuperacao-judicial/)

## 4. Base rates
- **Code baseline** (10-session returns from 0.68, last year weighted double): p5 0.44, p10 0.52, p25 0.59, **p50 0.64**, p75 0.69, p90 0.83, p95 1.05.
- **Recent 10-session moves** I worked out from the Yahoo data:
  - 30 Oct to 13 Nov: 0.69 to 0.68 (-1%)
  - About 9 Oct to 23 Oct: roughly flat around 1.44
  - 23 Oct to 6 Nov: 1.44 to 0.71 (-51%)
  - Late August to early September: 0.34 to about 0.75, more than doubling
- **Two regimes:** August to October saw frequent ±20-50% swings. Since 29 Oct the daily range has narrowed to about ±3-7%.
- **Seasonality:** I found nothing that makes late-November returns systematic, so I did not tabulate prior years. Black Friday sales news could matter, but results are not due until 10 December.

## 5. Other forecasts
- I found no Polymarket, Kalshi, Manifold or Metaculus market on BHIA3. None of the markets in your list match: "Bahia" is a football club and "Casas" are people. Kalshi's IBOVESPA year-high market is only loosely related.
- Sell-side coverage is minimal. Stockpulse rates it "Hold" overall with a technical "Sell".

## 6. Upcoming events before 27 Nov
- Nothing is scheduled. Q3 results are due 10 Dec and the recovery plan around late December, both after resolution.
- Things that could move the price without warning:
  - creditor or plan leaks, such as debt-to-equity conversion terms or a plan support agreement
  - a confirmed store-closure plan
  - court filings, including the trustee Oliveira Trust's R$75.1M transfer complaint ([Gazeta Mercantil](https://gazetamercantil.com/casas-bahia-bhia3-transferencia-75-milhoes-debentures-recuperacao-judicial))
  - a grupamento announcement (it could not take effect this quickly)
  - Black Friday (27 Nov) trading commentary
- The weather is not relevant.
